6.107 rsInvalidStaticDataGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidStaticDataGrouping is a critical error that will occur when a DataGrouping.Grouping element
contains a Grouping.GroupExpressions element and DataGrouping.Static is set to true.
